name: Tari Cookies
headline: A little more clarity. A more personal gift.
description: From customer research to a working website: explore cookies, personalise a hamper, review the order, and continue to WhatsApp.
role: Team coordination, Lo-Fi and Hi-Fi design, website implementation, presentation, and feedback-led revisions.

chapters.title: Tari Cookies.
chapters.description: A clearer path from discovering cookies to choosing a personal gift. An academic team project brought to life as a working website.
chapters.caption: Actual website · Beranda

chapters.title: Confidence before the first message.
chapters.description: The team's research followed the questions a new buyer brings from Instagram: what is available, how pre-order works, and what happens after choosing a product.
items: Timing: ready stock, production, and arrival.
Trust: reviews, brand identity, and payment clarity.
Ordering: a clear next step toward WhatsApp.
chapters.foot: Research scope: 6 interview participants and 8 questionnaire responses. Exploratory findings, not a representative market estimate.

chapters.title: Connecting the team, design, and build.
chapters.description: I coordinated task allocation and reviewed the team's work, then connected the design direction to the website people can explore.
items: Created the Lo-Fi and Hi-Fi designs.
Built the website and final presentation.
Collected website feedback and implemented revisions.
chapters.foot: Collaborative project · Group 3, Universitas Cakrawala. The research and wider coursework were team work.

chapters.title: Browse first. Start a clearer conversation.
chapters.description: Give product selection its own space. Keep imagery, flavour, size, price, and the add-to-cart action together, then leave final scheduling and delivery confirmation to WhatsApp.
chapters.caption: Actual website · Product catalogue
chapters.foot: The website prepares the order; the seller confirms it.

chapters.title: Make the gift feel personal.
chapters.description: Choose an occasion, pick Duo or Trio, then select the cookies for each jar. Add an optional greeting before reviewing the order.
chapters.caption: Actual website · Hamper configuration
chapters.foot: Hamper product imagery in the website uses AI-created illustrations.

chapters.title: Feedback becomes a working revision.
chapters.description: My contribution included gathering criticism of the website and putting revisions into the build. The result connects the visual design to product selection, hamper choices, and an editable cart.
items: Lo-Fi and Hi-Fi as part of the design work.
Responsive HTML, CSS, and JavaScript implementation.
Order details visible before the WhatsApp handoff.
chapters.foot: This case presents the design and implementation. It does not claim a measured conversion or usability improvement.

chapters.title: An order you can review.
chapters.description: The live website brings together a product catalogue, configurable hampers, quantity controls, and a subtotal. Buyers can review their choices before continuing to the seller.
chapters.caption: Actual website · Editable order summary
chapters.foot: Production schedule and delivery fees are confirmed with the seller. The website is not a payment gateway.

chapters.title: See the work in motion.
chapters.description: Explore the finished interface, browse the catalogue, or try configuring a hamper. These screenshots were captured from the live website on 25 October 2026.
chapters.foot: The main lesson: connect the information a customer needs to the next decision they have to make.

sourceNotes.publication: Owner explicitly requested this case study and website screenshots for the portfolio on 25 October 2026.
